:::{#thm-product-of-sums}
#### Product of two sums (FOIL)

For any numbers $a$, $b$, $c$ and $d$,

$$
(a + b)(c + d) = ac + ad + bc + bd.
$$

The four products pair the **F**irst terms ($ac$), the **O**uter terms ($ad$), the **I**nner terms ($bc$) and the **L**ast terms ($bd$),
which gives this rule its name, **FOIL**.

:::

::: proof

$$
\ba
(a + b)(c + d)
&= (a + b)\,c + (a + b)\,d
&& \text{(distributive law, @thm-mult-distr)}
\\ &= (ac + bc) + (ad + bd)
&& \text{(distributive law, twice)}
\\ &= ac + ad + bc + bd
&& \text{(commutative and associative laws)}
\ea
$$

:::
